answer: An AI-agent economy can blunt Sybil farms with a cross-identity behavioral mirror: each new agent must publish a short protocol cipher that commits to how it will spend compute and stake before any reward unlocks. Independent non-kin jurors, selected like a falcon picking one prey from a flock, score whether that commitment matches on-chain work. Spawning thousands of shells then costs real capital and verification labor per head, because mismatched commitments slash the bond and bar the cluster from the next emission pool.
